description.text: Students in this major mainly study computer hardware, software and basic theory, knowledge and skills, grasp basic ability for computer application system design and analysis, master basic ability for researching and developing computer software and hardware application technology, know about laws and regulations on computer, as well as the development trend of computer technology, and are able to adapt to the social demand on the rapid development of computer application and computer technology, and constantly update and expand professional knowledge.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Nanchang Hangkong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form for International Students (Attached)2. Valid physical examination report or health certificate issued by authoritative hospital of applicant’s home country.3. Senior high school graduation certificate and academic transcript issued by applicant’s senior high school or college entrance exam transcript4. Applicant’s passport and four photos of passport5. Certificate of capital source for the period of studying in China offered by the applicant

requirements.text: 1. Applicant must be non-Chinese citizen, obey laws of the People’s Republic of China, and abide by rules and disciplines of NCHU after enrolled;2. Applicant of undergraduate program must be senior high school students under the age of 22 with healthy body and excellent character and learning;3. Applicant of master program must be undergraduate students under the age of 30 with healthy body and excellent character and learning.4.Students applying for English-taught majors must be proficient in English listening, speaking, reading and writing, and able to successfully read the textbooks and materials for the major.
